posts.text: Trump winning means no war. War is simply not in the cards. Anyone talking about war with Iran is just out to lunch.
Wait, so Israel going to war with Iran without us is somehow proving me wrong? Are you stupid? (yes)
So, no war with Iran, no nukes. Wake me up when that changes, I'll gladly eat my words (until then, I'm right yet again)

The whole point - the entire point - was that we would be "dying for Israel" and have "boots on the ground" in Iran. That didn't happen - that WONT happen - and yet everyone is claiming victory. You're just missing the bigger picture here.

Many of us made our voices loud and clear that we didn't want to be embroiled in a forever war in the Middle East - but it was in good faith! Many denouncing Trump and MAGA were doing so because they're personally invested in seeing the administration fail. Big difference!
Can I get a war with Iran update? You guys had all those big spaces and posts about regime change, nuclear strikes and Americans dying for Israel. Can we get an update on that
No "war with Iran." Everyone said MAGA was "over" last week. Instead we got the biggest ever increase in ICE and border funding possible. Thank you TRUMP!
If there's a single US boot dropped on Iran during Trump's presidency, I'll make a video denouncing the entire MAGA movement.
Immigration is the greatest issue we face in the West. All of these people listed are pro immigration. I don't care if they're "based anti zionists" - they're the enemy

Of course there are no "boots on the ground" in Iran and these liars know this, they just want to score internet points for headpats from cult leader figures. I think boots on ground would be a big mistake and still do! But we have to see how this plays out.
Of course there are no boots on the ground in Iran, but even if there were, I don't care anymore. As long as He controls immigration, I don't care what happens.

Me: "I'm skeptical of these strikes and we should in no universe have boots on the ground in Iran, let's hope this resolves quickly and I'm willing to give Trump the benefit of the doubt." The price one pays for nuance on this app:
All these people do is lie - ive said the same and now that it's happening I hope it is resolved quickly and we can move onto other things
Like I've always said, I think it would be a massive mistake for some boots on the ground invasion of Iran. Clearly that's not happening and there's very little chance it will happen.

I explicitly opposed the Iran war from the outset and didn't call any reasonable critics "third worldists." This is very disappointing to see from you. The people attacking me daily were these retard righters. And you know full well the Zioshills hate me too.
